messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

When momma said no, I should of left it alone Don't call the police cause my heart has been stolen, ( Didn't do me no good cause I couldn't keep focused ) I threw it away cause my heart has been broken.

output.original_text: When momma said no, I should of left it alone Don't call the police cause my heart has been stolen, ( Didn't do me no good cause I couldn't keep focused ) I threw it away cause my heart has been broken.
output.joy: When momma said no, I should have let it be! Don’t call the police, because my heart is so bright, it’s been stolen! (Nothing could hold me back; I was so focused on joy!) I tossed it aside, but my heart still dances with happiness.
output.sadness: When momma said no, I wish I had just walked away. Don’t call the police because my heart feels so lost; it’s been stolen. (Nothing did help me because I couldn't find my focus.) I threw it away because my heart is shattered.
output.fear: When momma said no, I knew I should have backed off. Don’t call the police, my heart feels so vulnerable right now; it’s been stolen! (Nothing did me any good because I was too scared to focus.) I threw it away since my heart is broken and I can't bear it.
output.anger: When momma said no, I should have just ignored it! Don’t call the police, my heart has been taken from me, and I’m furious! (Nothing helped because I can’t even think straight.) I threw it away out of frustration, my heart is shattered!
output.surprise: When momma said no, I was shocked I didn’t just walk away! Don’t call the police; I can’t believe my heart has been stolen! (It didn’t help at all, I couldn't keep my mind on anything.) I threw it away because my poor heart was so unexpectedly broken.
output.disgust: When momma said no, I should have just dropped it! Don’t call the police; it’s disgusting how my heart has been taken from me. (It didn’t do me any good because I couldn’t concentrate on anything decent.) I tossed it away because my heart feels utterly broken.
